text: Polestar's 20-F states that Geely (Zhejiang Geely Holding Group Company Limited) is primarily owned and operated by Li Shufu; that Geely, through wholly and partially owned entities, owns a controlling number of equity interests in Volvo Cars; and that Li Shufu, as a controlling equity interest holder in Geely, effectively controls Geely and Volvo Cars. As of December 31, 2025, related parties owned 69.0% of the Group.
short: Polestar 20-F: Li Shufu controls Geely, Geely controls Volvo Cars; related parties owned 69.0% of the Group at end-2025.

source.name: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC, Annual Report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (SEC), related-party note
source.quote: Li Shufu, as a controlling equity interest holder in Geely, effectively controls Geely and Volvo Cars
